lockup.title: Portal - Escape Into Nature
lockup.subtitle: Focus, Sleep, Relax, Sounds
lockup.editorialDescription: Need to get away—or just focus? Portal immerses you in 3D audio from incredible locations around the globe. On iOS, tap for full-screen visuals (and the prettiest clock you’ve ever seen); on Mac, click to transform your desktop into gorgeous 4K video. Bonus: Pair compatible AirPods to experience it all in Spatial Audio.
lockup.shortEditorialDescription: Create your perfect soundscapes to relax and focus.

items.caption: GREAT ON iPHONE DUO
items.title: Learn a Language With CapWords
items.subtitle: See it, snap it, say it

lockup.title: CapWords: AI Language Tutor
lockup.subtitle: Real-Life Speaking Coach
lockup.editorialDescription: Snap a photo of an item—a coffee mug, traffic cone, cupcake, anything—and this delightful Apple Design Award–winning language-learning app transforms the photo into a sticker while telling you the name and pronunciation of each item.

items.title: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
items.subtitle: Watch, discover and stream!
items.editorialDescription: If you ever see a group of teenagers (or twenty- or thirtysomethings) filming themselves doing literally anything, know this: They’re probably making a video to share on TikTok. Its infinite scroll of new videos combines perfectly edited lip-synching, hilarious sketches, and mesmerizing dance moves with delightful special effects and filters. It’s hard not to fall in love with everyone’s fluffy pets, awkward parents, impressive glow-ups, fails of every kind, and songs and pop-culture references that spark a million memes.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Make awesome short music videos that you can share with the world.

items.title: Tinder Dating App: Date & Chat
items.subtitle: Meet New People & Date Singles
items.editorialDescription: More than just a dating app, Tinder has been updated to become one of the most engaging, fun, and social apps around. Of course, finding matches is still a huge highlight—but with smart group chats, an awesome Apple TV app, and Super Likes to go around, we’re swiping right on this one.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Get faster matches with Tinder Platinum’s extra features.

items.title: Sky Guide
items.subtitle: Star gaze constellation finder
items.editorialTagline: See the stars and planets above
items.editorialDescription: Study thousands of stars, comets, and satellites with Fifth Star Labs’ stunningly gorgeous astronomy app. Using a built-in compass, Sky Guide lets you easily locate constellations and other celestial bodies—or you can simply hold up your device and learn more about what’s in front of you via dramatic photos and detailed descriptions. A stirring soundtrack and a time-lapse feature that shows where the moon and other objects will be later make your stargazing experience even more enchanting.

items.title: Yelp: Food, Services & Reviews
items.subtitle: Discover Restaurants Around Me
items.editorialDescription: We all enjoy discovering new places and experiences but some of us don’t like to be surprised. If you’re one of those who prefers to research then Yelp is the right source for you. From restaurants and shops to night clubs and museums, check comments and ratings by fellow Yelpers and make sure you make the right choice.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Eat before or after? Explore all of your restaurant options.

items.title: Bluey: Let's Play!
items.subtitle: Fun Kids Game for Boys & Girls
items.developerTagline: Fun Kids Game for Boys & Girls
items.editorialDescription: The beloved Australian pups—Bluey, Bingo, Chilli, and Bandit—are all here in Bluey: Let’s Play! Featuring familiar characters and settings from the show, Bluey: Let’s Play! will have your little ones frolicking with garden gnomes, hunting for hidden long dogs, and more.

items.title: Toca Boca World: Game & Play
items.subtitle: Create & Roleplay Family Life
items.editorialDescription: The long-awaited moment for Toca Boca fans has arrived. Toca Boca World, the newest edition to the popular series, brings together all the Toca Life apps, letting your beloved characters from different apps mingle in one beautiful world. And this unique world keeps growing: The app continually updates with new areas to explore and characters to meet.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Enrich your child’s imagination through creative world-building.

items.title: Kiddopia: Kids Learning Games
items.subtitle: 3000+ Learning games for kids
items.editorialDescription: Join Captain Kidd, Barbie, PJ Masks, and friends in Kiddopia, an exciting world where little ones build new skills through play. Visit Math Whiz Island to practice counting, then hop over to Lingo Land for phonics fun. With so much to explore, every adventure is a chance to learn!
items.shortEditorialDescription: Engage kids with the essential early curriculum in a fun way.

items.title: LEGO® DUPLO® MARVEL
items.subtitle: Spider-Man + Avengers for Kids
items.tertiaryTitle:
Designed for iPad.
Not verified for macOS.

items.title: RISE: Sleep Tracker
items.subtitle: Become a morning person
items.editorialDescription: When it comes to getting the most out of your sleep, a tracker that can tell you much more than how many hours you’ve snoozed goes a long way. Rise does just that. It helps you understand how your activities impact your sleep health, and it focuses on sleep debt to help you close the gap between the sleep you need and the sleep you get.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Keep track of your night’s rest for a fresher start to your day.

items.title: Pok Pok | Montessori Preschool
items.subtitle: Toddler Learning Games 2-8+
items.editorialDescription: Pok Pok Playroom’s married founders set out to create a kids’ app parents wouldn’t have to mute in a restaurant—and to the delight of grown-up diners everywhere, they did it. Pok Pok Playroom is a free-play feast for little senses: There are switches to flip, gears to grind, and blobs to plop together, all drawn and designed by hand to make the app feel like a tactile, handcrafted toy. Endlessly inventive but never overwhelming, it’s a master class in how a simple app can sometimes feel the most advanced.

items.title: CARROT Weather: Alerts & Radar
items.subtitle: Local Forecasts & Live Maps
items.editorialDescription: Carrot provides the weather with a little more...personality. If you’re OK with sarcasm, political jokes, and the occasional insult, it might be right for you. (That said, you can opt out of Carrot’s snark by disabling its personality in settings.) But how good is it at the weather part? Pretty great. Carrot draws its data from Foreca, one of meteorology’s more accurate forecasting services.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Check the forecast from your wrist with Siri.

items.title: MUBI: Stream Great Cinema
items.subtitle: Hand-picked by our curators
items.editorialDescription: Curated by and for true cinephiles, this App Store Award–winning streaming app is one of our favorite ways to discover cult classics and modern masterpieces alike.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Discover cult classics, eye-opening docs and hard-to-find dramas.

header.title: Apps You Might’ve Missed
header.subtitle: These apps bring us serious joy

items.title: Election Coverage, Unlocked
items.subtitle: Explore election coverage, freely in the app.
items.detail: The major moments. The must-win races. Our election coverage is unlocked for a limited time in the app. No paywall.

lockup.title: NYTimes: US and World News
lockup.subtitle: Breaking News and Live Updates
lockup.editorialDescription: With Pulitzer Prize–winning coverage, provocative op-eds, in-depth video docs, and award-winning podcasts, The New York Times expands your understanding of the world. Get alerts for breaking news as well as updates for your favorite coverage areas, like politics, arts, fashion, travel, and science.

items.title: Restyle Your Handwriting ✍️
items.subtitle: Messy notes? Make them neat in one tap!
items.detail: Lasso your handwriting, tap Restyle and pick a style. Available in select languages.

lockup.title: Goodnotes: AI Notes, Docs, PDF
lockup.subtitle: Note taking, Planner & Journal
lockup.editorialDescription: Goodnotes is a digital notepad and PDF markup tool. And it’s very good at both. As a notepad, Goodnotes covers all the bases. Create notes with your keyboard or handwrite them with Apple Pencil. The app transforms your hand-drawn shapes into geometrically perfect ones. It’s also capable of recognizing your handwriting (even when you can’t) and converting it to text.
lockup.shortEditorialDescription: ‣ For an app that lets you convert handwriting into text, try Goodnotes.

items.title: Introducing Game Pulse
items.subtitle: A brand new way to follow the story of every game
items.detail: See every game’s story unfold in real time with Game Pulse. Live insights, key stats and highlights all in one place.

lockup.title: NBA: Live Games & Scores
lockup.subtitle: Basketball highlights & stats
lockup.editorialDescription: The official NBA app is your go-to source for all things basketball. Follow your favorite players and teams on and off the court with real-time scores, news, and schedules. Get exclusive behind-the-scenes looks and rim-rattling highlights in Moments, a mobile-friendly vertical scroll of short videos. And when it’s game time, stream out-of-market broadcasts live and on demand with an NBA League Pass subscription.
lockup.shortEditorialDescription: Subscribe to watch the season live.

items.title: Plan & Create on Apple Duo
items.subtitle: Make every day beautifully organized.
items.detail: Discover Zinnia on Apple Duo. Combine planning, journaling, creativity, and organization in one beautiful space.

lockup.title: Planner & Journal - Zinnia
lockup.subtitle: Calendar & Creative Notebook
lockup.shortEditorialDescription: Pick a journaling template and start recording your daily tasks and thoughts.

items.title: Unedo: Spanish Games + Stories
items.subtitle: Your next level in Spanish
items.editorialDescription: Unedo helps intermediate Spanish learners bridge the gap between speaking the language and truly understanding it, pairing familiar drills like daily word puzzles with original stories from local journalists in Mexico, Spain, Colombia, and Peru.

items.title: ElevenReader: Read Books Aloud
items.subtitle: Reader for Books, PDFs & Docs
items.editorialDescription: ElevenReader narrates books, articles, and PDFs in over 30 languages using hundreds of natural, expressive AI voices—including James Dean, Maya Angelou, Michael Caine, and other stars, through partnerships with the celebrities and their estates.

items.title: FocusFlight - Deepfocus Timer
items.subtitle: Take off into deep focus
items.editorialDescription: If you’re most productive at 30,000 feet, FocusFlight brings that same distraction-free mindset down to earth by re-creating the calm of Airplane Mode. Choose a destination based on how long you want to focus, then reach new heights of productivity.

items.title: Hypelist: Lists for Everything
items.subtitle: Movies, Music, Books & Places
items.tertiaryTitle:
Designed for iPhone.
Not verified for macOS.
items.editorialDescription: Classic albums, dreamy vacation destinations, must-read books—if you can track it, you can Hypelist it. The app’s robust tools help you catalog your favorites (manually or with a seamless import of screenshots or social media links) and share them with an engaging community.
